reason: An agent integration that exposes Godot editor control, inspection, debugging, project analysis, linting, and export operations through a loopback RPC bridge.

summaries.zh: 通过回环 RPC 桥让 AI agent 控制 Godot 4.x 编辑器，执行场景操作、项目检查、调试、代码 lint 和导出等开发任务。
summaries.en: Enables an AI agent to control the Godot 4.x editor through a loopback RPC bridge for scene operations, project inspection, debugging, linting, and export tasks.

capabilities: Communicates with the local Godot 4.x editor through a loopback TCP JSON-lines bridge
Opens and reloads scenes and starts or stops scene execution
Reads editor state, scene trees, node properties, debugger state, project files, scripts, and playback errors
Runs linting, resource inspection, and export operations
